item.title: The Coming Need for Formal Specification
item.description:
📝 I thought that the reason that testing and specifications would be useful was that AI agents would be struggling to “grok” coding for quite some time, and that you’d need to have robust specifications such that they could stumble toward correctness. Formal verification of code allows you to specify a system using mathematical proofs, and then exhaustively prove that a system is correct. There could still exist some untested input that would demonstrate incorrect behavior.
🔗 Read more: https://benjamincongdon.me/blog/2025/12/12/The-Coming-Need-for-Formal-Specification/

item.description:
